Every style is rendered in one shared palette of teal, coral pink and cream, so the whole figure reads as one harmonious composition. Her figure is divided into 5 diagonal bands by 4 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 33% of the way down her figure from the top, about 47% of the way down her figure from the top, about 59% of the way down her figure from the top and about 80% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries traditional Japanese irezumi tattoo art with peonies, waves and clouds rendered only in teal, coral pink and cream. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries Lichtenstein style Ben-Day dots and thick outlines rendered only in teal, coral pink and cream. Region 4 is the diagonal band between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries high-gloss enamel colour blocks with wet-looking highlights rendered only in teal, coral pink and cream. Region 5 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries Hokusai Great Wave style rolling waves with foam claws and bold linework rendered only in teal, coral pink and cream. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: bold white eyeshadow across the lids, white glossy lips, a bright turquoise liner accent at the outer corners, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows satin skin finish, smooth silky sheen.

Background: a bright spring garden terrace of pale stone with blooming tulip beds, a low trimmed hedge, a standard-height garden gate and a bench, in warm golden late-afternoon light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor.
